messages:
nate (eng-runtime): Quick heads-up — we just put the first wave of dedicated RTX-9500 pools live in SIN and AMS :rocket:. Rolling to a small set of reserved customers for validation.
priya (eng-ops): Details? sizes / counts / burst policy?
leo (infra): Initial capacity: SIN: 24 devices (6 nodes x 4 GPUs), AMS: 20 devices (5 nodes x 4 GPUs). Burst policy: 2x short-burst for 15m, then rate-limit to baseline.
jessica (product): Target customers for preview are PSU/enterprise with high-throughput inference. We'll surface in Console as rtx-9500-dedicated-<region>.
amanda (sales): Pinged a couple of trial accounts, they were asking about latency vs H200. Any perf guidance?
nate (eng-runtime): Early numbers look promising on 8k-context models for throughput. Latency comparable to H200 for 2k sequences, better batching for long sequences. We'll publish perf snippets in the doc.
deploy-bot: deploy completed: rtx-9500-pool-sin v1.0 -> success (2161234568) :white_check_mark:
infra-bot: health checks green for rtx-9500-pool-ams (2161234572)
priya (eng-ops): Important ops note: driver stack is 535.x — there are known model runtime differences with older kernels. If you see unexpected CUDA errors, please collect /var/log/redwood/runtime.log and tag #eng-runtime.
leo (infra): Billing SKU: dedicated.rtx9500.<region>.units — note that initial pricing is provisional until we validate utilization. Finance ok with preliminary rate.
jessica (product): Two policy changes for Dedicated previews: 1) reservation hold window = 48h for preview pools (customers must confirm within 48h or reservation released). 2) No autoscale-to-zero for RTX-9500 pools during preview. We'll revert after stabilization.
amanda (sales): Noted. Communicating hold window to pilot customers now.
priya (eng-ops): Oncall playbook snippet: fallback model route -> if pool utilization > 95% for 10m, route new requests to rtx-9000-compatible pool (with 10% QOS penalty). Escalation: @nate -> 10m, @leo -> 30m.
nate (eng-runtime): Also add cache invalidation guidance: rolling deploys may require KV cache warmup; recommend warm-start with synthetic traces.
leo (infra): Known issue logged: occasional pod OOM on model X-8k when quantized to int4. Workaround: pin model_instance.memory_limit to +8%. Ticket INC-2161 created.
priya (eng-ops): Ops checklist for tomorrow's wider rollout: 1) confirm telemetry OK, 2) finalize pricing publish, 3) update console SKU mapping, 4) add rtx-9500 to automated failover policy.
jessica (product): Reminder: marketing announcement scheduled after we hit 72h steady-state and zero critical incidents. Tentative window Fri EOD.
amanda (sales): I'll delay external comms until we hit the 72h safety gate.
priya (eng-ops): Quick ask to eng teams: if you onboard customers to these pools, add the tag "preview-rtx9500" to the workspace so we can track regressions per-customer.
nate (eng-runtime): noted. We'll also push a small perf dashboard tile that shows p99 token latency and unit cost per model family.
infra-bot: metric alert suppressed: rtx-9500-pool-sin.high-cpu (suppression window 10m)
leo (infra): If you run into driver mismatches in DEV, repro steps: run `docker run --rm --gpus all nvidia/cuda:12.1-base nvidia-smi` and check kernel module. Share output in thread.
priya (eng-ops): Thanks team. I'll post the rollout schedule and runbook in #eng-oncall in 10m.
jessica (product): One more: feature flag name is feature:dedicated_rtx9500_preview. Ops please keep it off by default for non-pilot tenants.
amanda (sales): Copy that.
nate (eng-runtime): TL;DR: RTX-9500 dedicated preview live in SIN/AMS, limited capacity, provisional pricing, preview policies (48h hold, no autoscale-to-zero), ops/runbook and perf dashboards incoming. Please escalate any infra/model regressions to #eng-runtime and tag incidents with INC-2161.
priya (eng-ops): Closing loop: next update after 24h steady-state or earlier if incidents. :spiral_calendar_pad:
